fee_notes: Single-unit Initial Franchise Fee is $49,500. Under a Multiple Unit Franchise Agreement, fees are $49,500 for the 1st store, $44,500 for the 2nd, $39,500 for the 3rd, and $34,500 for the 4th and subsequent stores. A $15,000 Multiple Unit Territory Fee per store is credited against future Initial Franchise Fees. A $10,000 discount is available for qualifying veterans, active/retired firefighters, police officers, EMT/paramedics, nurses, and teachers off the first store fee. Existing franchisees in good standing for 36+ months may open one additional store at a discounted Initial Franchise Fee of $15,000 (lowest possible value). All fees are non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: The "Initial Franchise Fee" for an individual unit franchise is $49,500 for each Store. ... Under the Multiple Unit Franchise Agreement, the Initial Franchise Fee for the first Store is $49,500, the Initial Franchise Fee for the second Store is $44,500, the Initial Franchise Fee for the third Store is $39,500, and the Initial Franchise Fee for the fourth and subsequent Store is $34,500. ... We also offer existing franchisees who have been operating a Store for a minimum of 36 months, and who are in good standing under their Franchise Agreement(s), the opportunity to enter into a Franchise Agreement for one additional Store during the initial term of their first Franchise Agreement for a discounted Initial Franchise Fee of $15,000.
